story.fullStory:
Mary Hopkin's "Goodbye" reached #13 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Goodbye" is a song written by Paul McCartney (but credited to Lennon–McCartney) and performed by Mary Hopkin.

The song peaked at #13 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Goodbye was released in 1969.

"Goodbye" is a song written by Paul McCartney (but credited to Lennon–McCartney) and performed by Mary Hopkin.

Background The song was conceived as a follow-up to the success of Hopkin's first single, produced by McCartney, titled "Those Were the Days", which was highlighted on her debut album Postcard, one of the first records issued by the newly founded Apple Records.
